purpose: Distinguish training-seed variation from dependence on the available background proxy groups
unit: 15 heldout background proxy groups; sample15 groups with replacement; preserve every image within each sampled group
comparison: Mean across all three paired seeds of combined-minus-reference UAV AP50:95; both models use identical sampled groups
interval: Descriptive percentile 2.5/97.5 interval, conditional on the fitted weights and proxy grouping. Not certified scene-generalization confidence; groups may remain related.
leave_one_group_out: Report range of mean paired gain after omitting each of15 groups; no refitting
worst_group: Report per-group results for groups with>=10 UAV boxes, chosen by labels only. No deployment claim from few groups.
validation: Cached COCO per-image matching and repeated-image accumulation must match the unchanged evaluator on the original data and fixed resampled miniature cases before reported use.
